Why it holds

No answer key.
No inventory.
No free money.

The Wheel is not a quiz, a marketplace, or a loan. It is a settlement engine for a real savings circle. The money to pay the winner comes from the members' own contributions — captured before the auction opens.

  • Cheat-resistant by construction. A discount bid makes walking away expensive. The bond, guarantor, and fund are all on the hook.
  • No external capital. The pot is funded by the circle. The platform earns 1% of each settled pot, not from a sponsor.
  • Instant and legible. Every movement is a ledger entry. The settlement receipt shows the pot, the discount, the fees, the bond, and every patience share.

Rulebook · v0.1

Short rules.
Hard edges.

The circle votes with its feet. These are the defaults every member accepts before joining. The organizer can narrow them, never widen them.

01 The pot is whole before it moves

Every active member must fund the turn. If someone misses the window, the organizer resolves the shortfall from the fund, the guarantor, or their own wallet. The auction cannot open on a partial pot.

02 Sealed discount, highest wins

Bids are sealed and cannot be edited. The discount is between 1% (or KES 50, whichever is greater) and 25% of the pot. A tie goes to the earliest bid. No bids means a random eligible member wins at 0%.

03 The last turn has no auction

When one member is left without a payout, they take the whole pot at 0% discount and no bond. The circle closes after that turn.

04 Bond, guarantor, fund

New members hold a 25% bond, falling to 20%, 15%, and 10% with a clean history. A member can have one guarantor; a member can guarantee up to two others. The fund earns 1% of every pot plus late fees and forfeited bonds.

05 Fees are visible

Platform 1%. Organizer 0–1.5%, chosen at creation. Guarantee fund 1%. Late fee 2% with a 10% cap after a 24-hour grace. If the organizer wins, the organizer fee goes to the fund.

06 Identity before money out

The organizer verifies each member's phone and identity in person before the first payout. The first payout is held for 48 hours. Later payouts settle immediately.

THE WHEEL is a record-keeping and settlement service for private savings circles. It is not a bank, lender, or deposit-taking institution. Member funds are held only for settlement in the circle.
